importTracking.details: Inspects ts.isImportDeclaration; captures named imports, property aliases (origName !== localName), namespace imports, and flags authority modules.

reexportTracking.details: Inspects ts.isExportDeclaration; flags passthrough or re-exported authority symbols as SUSPICIOUS_UNKNOWN.

classPropertyTracking.details: Inspects ts.isClassDeclaration and ts.isPropertyDeclaration; extracts initializer call expressions to issueSealingCapability, parsing authorized context and domains.

variableStatementTracking.details: Inspects ts.isVariableStatement; tracks issueSealingCapability calls, object literal forged capabilities, property access function aliases, and revokeAllCapabilities calls.

callExpressionInspection.details: Deep AST traversal visiting ts.isCallExpression; unwraps parenthesized, as-expressions, and non-null assertions; inspects callee names, aliases, and property access.

dynamicAndComputedDetection.details: Detects computed bracket property access on authority targets and dynamic import() expressions, flagging calls as UNRESOLVED_UNKNOWN.

reflectionAndEvalDetection.details: Detects Reflect.get, new Function, and eval referencing sealing interfaces, flagging calls as UNRESOLVED_UNKNOWN.

failClosedClassification.details: Any unresolved callpath forces module classification to AUTHORITY_PRODUCER_WITH_UNRESOLVED_PATHS or SUSPICIOUS_UNKNOWN; zero permissive default fallbacks.

site1.validationAtSeal: Verified. CanonicalDomainBindingEngine.sealBinding calls computeHMACSealToken which invokes validateCapability(capability, domain).

defenseInDepthEvidence: 1. Internal capability registry (Map<string, SealingCapability>) stores instances.
2. validateCapability enforces instance reference equality (registered === capability), rejecting structural clones.
3. Authorized domains array is checked against target domain on every seal call.
4. revokeAuthorityState() and revokeAllCapabilities() clear registry, immediately invalidating cached references.
5. System boot gate (initializationState === 'INITIALIZED') must pass before seal computation is permitted.
